tools.name: get_business_facts
tools.description: The published facts about Commercial Garage Doorman: what it does, the phone number, opening hours, the towns it serves, its services, and how it handles pricing. Every fact here also appears on the public website. Call this first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over the pages of the Commercial Garage Doorman website. Returns page ids, titles and canonical URLs. Use fetch with an id to read a page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one page of the Commercial Garage Doorman website, as Markdown, with its canonical URL for citation. The id comes from search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

confidence.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
confidence.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, request_quote · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, request_quote · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

confidence.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
